query: Polyethylene film for greenhouse enclosures . Allows greenhouse polyethylene film that does not meet the tent-film standard for staff-only plant-growing facilities. Applies to: Commercial plant-growing greenhouses closed to the public.
Energy efficiency Tier 1 of [ref] . Explains Alberta’s Tier 1 housing energy requirements and distinguishes voluntary higher tiers. Applies to: Housing/small-building energy compliance under [ref]

Roof truss layout for one- and two-family dwellings. Historical roof-truss documentation bulletin for one- and two-family dwellings; now archived. Applies to: Former truss submission/authentication arrangements.

Building roof trusses for one- and two-family dwellings. Historical roof-truss documentation bulletin for one- and two-family dwellings; now archived. Applies to: Former truss submission/authentication arrangements.

2021 Canadian Electrical Code, Part I, Section 64. Archived joint electrical variance/building bulletin addressing residential energy-storage installations before adoption of the newer electrical code. Applies to: Historical residential ESS installations under the 2021 electrical code.

Occupancy of buildings under construction. Provides guidance for AHJ permission to occupy completed parts of buildings while construction continues. Applies to: Phased occupancy, occupied additions and alterations.

SEER2 and HSPF2 application. Explains SEER2/HSPF2 equipment-efficiency metrics and their relationship to code requirements. Applies to: Electrically operated air-cooled air conditioners and heat pumps under NBC(AE)/NECB.
Houses with a secondary suite. Consolidates dispersed Part 9 secondary-suite provisions for navigation alongside the actual code. Applies to: Houses with a secondary suite.

Access to roof-mounted HVAC equipment. Consolidates requirements for safe access to rooftop HVAC equipment with the newer gas-installation standard context. Applies to: Roof-mounted HVAC equipment under the building/gas codes.
Radon/soil gas pipe labelling. Identifies labelling requirements for radon/soil-gas piping and distinguishes Part 3 and Part 9 routes. Applies to: Radon rough-in/active soil-depressurization piping.

Use of shipping containers (sea-cans) for storage. Explains building/fire-code treatment of storage sea-cans and why normal prefabricated steel-building certifications do not automatically cover them. Applies to: Shipping containers for material storage with authorized-personnel access.

Overnight child care. Distinguishes residential dayhomes from daycare occupancies offering overnight care and consolidates their safety requirements. Applies to: Licensed overnight child-care dayhomes/daycares.
Occupant loads. Coordinates design and operational occupant-load calculations for assembly uses. Applies to: Assembly occupancies/licensed beverage establishments under building and fire authorities.

NFPA 33 spray booths, application of the safety codes. Clarifies permits and the use of NFPA 33 for spray-finishing systems where the building code relies on good engineering practice. Applies to: Spray booths, areas and rooms involving flammable/combustible materials.

Smoke detectors in smoke or fire/smoke damper installation. Clarifies whether damper-operating smoke detectors must connect to a building fire alarm system. Applies to: Smoke/fire-smoke dampers in HVAC systems.

Fixed fire suppression and exhaust systems – cooking, cleaning, maintenance and qualified persons. Separates installation/design authority from ongoing fire-code maintenance duties for commercial cooking suppression/exhaust systems. Applies to: Commercial kitchen fixed suppression and exhaust systems.

Special events. Explains multi-discipline safety-code permitting and emergency planning for special events. Applies to: Indoor/outdoor events requiring permits, occupant-load assessment or emergency planning.

Existing fire alarm systems. Explains maintenance, replacement, modernization and alternative-solution options for existing fire alarm systems. Applies to: Existing fire alarm systems of any age undergoing work or testing.

Integrated testing coordinator. Defines the professional qualifications of an integrated testing coordinator for fire/life-safety systems. Applies to: Integrated testing of fire-protection/life-safety systems and interacting building systems.

Wood roof truss systems in Part 9 buildings. Requires engineered/authenticated wood trusses and their connections as an assembly, including necessary interface information. Applies to: Wood trusses and roof assemblies in Part 9 buildings.

Design of wood trusses for roof assemblies in Part 9 buildings. Requires engineered/authenticated wood trusses and their connections as an assembly, including necessary interface information. Applies to: Wood trusses and roof assemblies in Part 9 buildings.

Barrier-free design requirements: relaxations. Distinguishes AHJ assessment of code-exempt accessibility situations from a provincial barrier-free relaxation request. Applies to: Projects assessed for the listed barrier-free exceptions/uses.

Photoluminescent exit signs. Explains when charging lights for listed photoluminescent exit signs need not connect to emergency power. Applies to: Photoluminescent exit signs and their dedicated charging lights.

Guard requirements for glazing in a window. Discusses fall/collision protection for low glazing and openable windows; the official publication is on hold under review. Applies to: Window glazing positioned where guard/fall-protection concerns arise.

Mechanically vented appliances. Clarifies appliance categories and when combustion systems need protection against dwelling depressurization. Applies to: Fuel-fired space/water-heating appliances and dwelling ventilation.

Energy efficiency exemptions for buildings. Identifies certain building uses that may be exempt from the building energy-efficiency provisions. Applies to: Listed low-occupancy industrial/equipment shelters and specific impractical-to-comply uses.

Service/utility room for energy storage systems. Assigns building-SCO review of energy-storage-system room construction and clarifies dual permit needs. Applies to: Service/utility rooms required by the identified electrical-code ESS rules.

Measures to mitigate fire spread to adjacent buildings. Consolidates building/fire-code considerations for reducing fire spread during construction/demolition. Applies to: Construction/demolition sites from houses to multistorey buildings.

Elevator operation and accessibility for residential buildings. Clarifies the duty to maintain operational elevating devices serving a required accessible path in residential buildings. Applies to: Residential buildings whose required barrier-free path is served by an elevator/platform device.

Attached garage serving a house with a secondary suite. Explains the garage-separation exception where an attached garage serves a house with a secondary suite. Applies to: Attached storage garages for five vehicles or fewer serving that house/suite arrangement.
Lightning protection systems. Clarifies the applicable lightning-protection standard and electrical permitting. Applies to: New/altered/added lightning-protection systems.

Firefighters' Emergency Operation for alterations (FEO). Clarifies whether alterations to existing elevators require firefighters’ emergency-operation upgrades. Applies to: Existing elevating devices where FEO was not originally installed/required.

Hydronic heating systems. Explains design/submission and verification for hydronic systems heating building interiors. Applies to: Primary/secondary interior hydronic heat; excludes systems such as exterior snowmelt that do not heat the building interior.

Electromagnetic locks – installation, maintenance, testing, and verification. Coordinates permits, professional involvement and qualified installation/testing of electromagnetic locks connected to fire alarms. Applies to: New/existing maglock installations and their maintenance/testing/verification.

Window opening control devices (WOCD). Accepts ASTM F2090 window-opening control devices for both fall protection and bedroom escape requirements in eligible Part 9 residential occupancies. Applies to: Part 9 residential windows subject to the cited guard/bedroom escape requirements.
Insulation below a heated floor. Accepts a specified minimum under-slab insulation value for heated floors in ground contact. Applies to: Heated floors in contact with ground.

Sprinkler-protected glazing in fire-resistant wall assemblies. Accepts listed sprinkler-protected glazing in qualifying rated wall assemblies as an alternative to the normal fire-endurance test route. Applies to: Interior/exterior fire-resistance-rated wall glazing within the listing and variance limits.

Occupancy classification of oil and gas processing buildings. Allows small oil/gas processing buildings to use an F2 occupancy classification when an engineered risk assessment and compensating safeguards address the hazards. Applies to: Oil/gas processing buildings no larger than 150 m².

Maximum span values for joists, rafters and beams. Accepts maximum joist, rafter and beam spans from the 2020 Canadian Wood Council Span Book. Applies to: Part 9 wood framing within the referenced 2020 Span Book scope.

008(REV1) - Residential exhaust outlet clearance from air intakes. Allows moisture-bearing residential exhaust outlets to use the clearance geometry in the variance diagram. Applies to: Residential exhaust outlets and air intakes within this variance.

Residential exhaust outlet clearance from air intakes. Historical version allows reduced horizontal clearance between certain residential exhaust outlets and their own air intake. Applies to: Kitchen, bathroom and clothes-dryer exhaust serving an individual dwelling or house with secondary suite.

CSA B52:23 Mechanical refrigeration code. Recognizes CSA B52:23 as an alternative refrigeration installation standard under the Alberta building code. Applies to: Mechanical refrigeration installations addressed by the NBC(AE).

Engineer authentication for the qualification of structural steel fabricators. Allows professionally authenticated welding controls instead of the normal fabricator certification route for qualifying structural-steel fabrication. Applies to: Structural steel fabricated by non-CSA W47.1-certified fabricators.

Engineer's authentication for welding procedures. Accepts a registered-engineer welding equivalency route for fabricators not certified to CSA W47.1. Applies to: Structural-steel welding/fabrication within the variance scope.

Polyethylene film for greenhouse enclosures. Adds a tightly scoped public-retail greenhouse option while retaining the staff-only plant-growing option for polyethylene film. Applies to: Staff-only plant growing, or a qualifying one-storey F3 greenhouse selling plants/horticultural products.

Permanent wood foundations with mechanically laminated timber panels for Part 9 residential buildings. Recognizes a specific engineered guide for mechanically laminated timber panel permanent wood foundations in eligible Part 9 housing. Applies to: Residential MLTP foundations within the guide and prescriptive-foundation scope.

Elevator and passenger-elevating devices. Allows a passenger elevator in place of an accessibility platform lift or LULA with revised travel/car-size and FEO conditions. Applies to: Elevators substituted for accessibility lifts or LULA in the joint building/elevating-device variance.

Multi-level storage racking systems. Treats qualifying multilevel storage racks as special/unusual structures under a detailed alternative design package. Applies to: Authorized-personnel storage/retrieval racks in permitted industrial or mercantile buildings.

Unvented roof assembly. Allows unvented Part 9 residential roof assemblies designed under the specifically referenced building-science evaluation report. Applies to: Part 9 residential roof assemblies within the report scope.

Vented soffit protection. Accepts tested intumescent-coated vented soffit materials as an alternative to specified non-vented/protective soffit construction. Applies to: Soffits within the listed Part 9 exposure-protection situations.

query: Construction of Exposed Building Face (Revision 3). query: Firewall in a Rowhouse with Secondary Suites. Accepts a package of compartmentation, egress and service protections instead of the prescribed firewall in qualifying rowhouses with secondary suites. Applies to: Calgary rowhouses containing more than two houses with secondary suites.
